summary: Patio brunch, a dog loving coffee shop and a Sunday fundraiser make this a social weekend. Heads up: David H. Ready Dog Park is closed until December 23 and Demuth Park's dog parks are closed until early November.
heatNote: Highs run about 81 to 88°F. Mornings are most comfortable. Bring water and a bowl, ask for shaded seating, and press the back of your hand on pavement for 7 seconds: if it is too hot for you, it is too hot for paws. Recheck wind before sitting outside.

picks.name: Boozehounds brunch
picks.when: Friday to Sunday, 10 am to 3 pm
picks.where: 2080 N. Palm Canyon Drive, Palm Springs
picks.why: A restaurant built for dogs and their people, so the tables around you are full of fellow dog owners. Dogs are welcome on the shaded patio and open air atrium.
picks.check: Reserve a dog friendly table and confirm there is no private event. 760 656 0067.

picks.name: 4 Paws Coffee Co.
picks.when: Saturday and Sunday, 6:30 am to 3 pm (8 to 9 am is a nice time)
picks.where: 2500 N. Palm Canyon Drive, Suite A5, Palm Springs
picks.why: A neighborhood coffee shop centered on dogs and community, which makes easy conversations with other dog owners natural.
picks.check: Keep your dog leashed and ask about shaded seating and water. 760 832 8021.

picks.name: Sips & Psychics animal fundraiser
picks.where: Sottovoce Café, 73575 El Paseo, Suite 1320, Palm Desert
picks.why: Coffee and conversation with pet lovers, raising money for Desert Paws Sanctuary and the Coachella Valley Cat Club. Pets are welcome.
picks.check: Call to confirm fees, dog seating and whether you need a reservation. 760 833 2909.

picks.name: Palm Springs Air Museum
picks.where: 745 N. Gene Autry Trail, Palm Springs
picks.why: A fresh outing with air conditioned hangars where friendly, leashed dogs are welcome, and plenty of visitors to chat with.
picks.check: Ask about flight demonstrations or loud engine noise before bringing a noise sensitive dog. 760 778 6262.

picks.name: Whitewater Preserve Canyon View Loop
picks.when: Saturday or Sunday, start by 8 am
picks.where: Whitewater Preserve, about 25 minutes northwest of Palm Springs
picks.why: A dog friendly 3.5 mile hike with mountain views, popular with hikers who bring their dogs.
picks.check: Confirm preserve hours and leash rules, and check wind conditions in the pass before you drive out.
